Privacy Policy

Last updated: 17 October 2026

This Privacy Policy explains what happens to information when you visit snakearcadegame.com (the "Site") and play the games on it. It covers the whole Site, including the game pages and this policy page. By using the Site you agree to what is described here.

1. The Short Version

  • You do not need an account, an email address or any personal information to play.
  • We do not ask you to submit any personal information, and there is nowhere on the Site to do so.
  • Your game score and settings are stored in your own browser, on your own device. They are not sent to us.
  • The Site shows advertising, and advertising partners use cookies. That is described in section 4.

2. Information We Do Not Collect

Playing a game on this Site does not require registration, login or payment. We do not operate a user database, and we do not collect names, email addresses, postal addresses, phone numbers, payment details or account credentials, because there is no form or account through which to provide them.

3. Information Stored on Your Device

The game saves a small amount of data in your browser's local storage so that the Site works the way you expect:

  • your highest score, so it is still there when you return;
  • your selected speed setting;
  • cached game files, so the Site can load instantly and keep working offline after your first visit.

This data stays on your device. It is not transmitted to us, and we cannot read it. Clearing your browser data for this Site deletes all of it. You can also remove it from within your browser's site settings at any time.

4. Cookies and Advertising

The Site is supported by advertising. Advertising is served through third-party advertising networks, including Google AdSense.

  • Third party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to this website or other websites.
  • Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to users based on their visit to this Site and/or other sites on the Internet.
  • Users may opt out of personalised advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings. You can opt out of some third-party vendors' use of cookies for personalised advertising at www.aboutads.info.

These cookies are set by the advertising networks, not by us. We do not have access to the information they collect, and we do not control how they use it. Their handling of your data is governed by their own privacy policies, which we recommend reading. If you are in a region that requires consent for advertising cookies, you will be shown a consent notice before those cookies are set, and you can decline or later withdraw your consent through that notice or your browser settings.

Most browsers let you block or delete cookies in their settings. Blocking cookies does not prevent you from playing the games on this Site.

5. Analytics

We may use privacy-respecting analytics to understand how many people visit the Site and which pages are used, so that we can fix problems and improve the games. This information is aggregated: it tells us that a page was viewed, not who viewed it. It is not used to identify you personally and is not combined with information that could identify you.

6. Children's Privacy

The Site is a general-audience game site and is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. Because the Site has no accounts and no forms, there is no mechanism through which a child could provide personal information to us. If you believe a child has somehow provided personal information through the Site, please contact us using the details on our Contact page and we will act on it.

7. Your Rights

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete or restrict the processing of your personal information, and to object to certain processing. Because we do not collect personal information through the Site, in most cases there is nothing held by us to access or delete — the game data sits in your own browser and you can clear it yourself. If you believe we hold information about you and want to exercise a right, contact us through the Contact page and we will respond.

8. Data Security and Retention

The Site is served over HTTPS. We keep no user database and therefore retain no personal information about players. Because game data lives in your browser, how long it is kept is decided by your own browser settings, not by us.

9. External Links

The Site may link to other websites. We are not responsible for their content or their privacy practices, and this policy does not apply to them.

10. Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy when the Site or the services it uses change. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last revised. Continuing to use the Site after a change means you accept the updated policy.

11. Contact

Questions about this policy or about data handling on this Site are welcome. Please use the details on our Contact page.
